calibration.finding: Assigned competition population and supplied plans; 51 link dimensions flagged approximate.

calibration.value: truncated normal, mean 1.2 before age adjustment
calibration.finding: Single-file experiments relate spacing and speed; they do not identify this mixed audience distribution.
calibration.limit: Elderly share .25 and factor .78 remain assumptions; no Bailey trajectories.

calibration.finding: Seyfried reports spacing d=0.36+1.06v over 0.1–1.0 m/s; Johansson studies constant net headway. Definitions differ.
calibration.limit: Body diameter .44 m plus H is not the complete fit from either experiment.

calibration.finding: Eight campus lecture-room trials: imposing 0.45 m/s generally overpredicted time; 0.60 was another numerical model, not their measured estimate.
calibration.limit: Mostly young familiar lecture users; conservative value retained for concert.

calibration.value: individual free speed × inherited stair ratio
calibration.finding: NIST TN1839 (2015), Table 5: 5244 observed stair journeys, overall mean .44, SD .19 m/s; congested realized speeds must not be substituted for uncongested desired speeds.
calibration.limit: Different stair geometry and occupancy; no Bailey stair calibration.

calibration.finding: Theatre network trials require aisle and exit constraints; obstacle studies do not establish a universal capacity gain.
calibration.limit: No measured Bailey saturated flow. Faster-is-slower and luggage factors retained.

calibration.finding: Capacity follows J=v/(d+vH); space is reserved for ALL occupants. No timed overflow. No extra density multiplier on the same queue delay.
calibration.limit: Link averages, not contact forces or precise crowd pressure.

calibration.finding: Unannounced theatre evidence supports response heterogeneity and seat-position dependence.
calibration.limit: Exact medians, social acceleration and spatial coefficients not fitted to Bailey.

calibration.value: readiness wait ≤90; local pace within existing 4 m on same link
calibration.finding: 108 recorded participants in groups of 3 vs individuals; longer response/approach, no discernible difference immediately before exits.
calibration.limit: Small artificial groups; experiment does not estimate 4 m. No speed bonus at a gate.

calibration.value: persistent random utility; 8 s / 15% improvement; 6 s review cooldown
calibration.finding: Route-choice experiments support response to travel and queues with relatively infrequent revisions.
calibration.limit: Preferences and thresholds not Bailey measured; perceived cost contains only visible/communicated conditions.

calibration.finding: Controlled unfamiliar-building trials: dynamic-sign detection 77% head-on, 72% oblique versus 39%/37% static; most who noticed followed.
calibration.limit: Not a dense theatre. Floor-strip transfer especially uncertain; 2017 combined voice/sign 66% is not notice probability.

calibration.finding: Static-sign detection near 38% in an unfamiliar building; not repeated independent lottery every second.
calibration.source: Xie et al. (2012); Galea et al. (2014)
calibration.limit: Existing sign positions inferred from exit nodes; exact mounting heights/photometry unavailable.

calibration.value: 6; fixed .80 acceptance; 12 m acoustic reach; activation lognormal median10
calibration.finding: Sign/voice trials support consistent messages; no retrieved Bailey experiment identifies manager compliance .80.
calibration.limit: Hearing differs from acceptance and execution. Local observations delayed 2 s; radio 3 s, reliability .9.

calibration.value: slot footprint; one bypass ≥1.1 m or alternate-route closure; no gain
calibration.range: No device / partial belt / open rail
calibration.finding: Diversion devices can increase or decrease flow; S-shaped rails may lower density while lengthening time.
calibration.source: Wang et al. (2023); Chen et al. (2023)
calibration.limit: 1.1 m is a research screening rule, not code certification. Actual installation needs Fire Marshal approval.
